text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf throws body and soul into 
her training for the upcoming Nippon 
Derby. Air Groove watches on, deeply 
worried for her well-being.

A plan was made to ease the President's 
burden by restricting access to the 
Student Council room, but Symboli Rudolf 
could not agree to it.

While empathizing with Air Groove's 
feelings, as Student Council President and 
as the "Emperor," she never stopped moving 
forward.
